note: The story has status 'User Story Removed': the verdict stays Removed even though code exists, no diagram, not claimed. Code found: furnish by staff (staff-furnish/*) and PLUS (/plus-furnish) through StaffFurnishService, and officer manual furnish (/furnish/officer/manual/single). Important finding: foreign-vehicle notices are created with an active PS-FOR (CreateNoticeHelper.java:175) and FurnishabilityChecker.checkPermanentSuspension rejects ALL active PS without exception (FurnishabilityChecker.java:340-348), although the javadoc of StaffFurnishService.java:83-85 says PS-FOR is allowed. As a result the staff-furnish and PLUS paths block foreign-vehicle notices until the PS-FOR is revived; the /furnish/officer/manual path only checks stage (ManualFurnishValidationService.java:33-58) so it does not block, but no caller exists in ocmsadminui. Appendix B/Annex 1A is not in the repo so the 'automated processing workflow' cannot be verified from the repo. PLUS endpoint authorization: JwtFilter skips plus-* so protection depends on APIM, which is not visible in the repo. No maintenance ticket was relevant enough to use for the verdict.

steps.step: The offending vehicle is recognised as a foreign vehicle (type F) and its notice is outstanding
steps.detail: When the notice is created, vehicle type F triggers createForeignVehicleSuspension which inserts PS-FOR into suspended_notice (CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:1197-1205; CreateNoticeHelper.java:148-176). Type F recognition exists; but PS-FOR becomes active at once, which affects the next furnish steps.

steps.step: The officer updates/furnishes driver's particulars manually in OCMS
steps.detail: The staff portal calls staff-furnish/furnish-redirect-check (ocmsadminui useODH.tsx:106) which goes through FurnishabilityChecker; checkPermanentSuspension rejects a notice with any active PS, including FOR (FurnishabilityChecker.java:107-110,340-348, message MSG_PS_SUSPENDED). The javadoc at StaffFurnishService.java:83-85 says FOR is excepted, but the code does not except it. So foreign-vehicle notices are blocked until the PS-FOR is revived. The /furnish/officer/manual/single path only checks stage (ManualFurnishValidationService.java:33-58) and does not block, but nothing in ocmsadminui calls it.

steps.step: Driver's particulars are furnished through PLUS
steps.detail: POST /plus-furnish calls staffFurnishService.staffFurnish (PlusIntegrationController.java:136-148), which starts with the same checkFurnishable (StaffFurnishService.java:175-186), so a foreign-vehicle notice with an active PS-FOR is rejected with HTTP 422. JwtFilter skips plus-* endpoints, protection depends on APIM: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: After furnishing, the notice moves to the driver stage (DN1) per the automated processing workflow
steps.detail: staffFurnish replaces the offender and sets the stage to DN1 for a driver (StaffFurnishService.java:238-258, determineNewStage :924-931). This is the generic furnish flow, with no foreign-vehicle branch. Appendix B / Annex 1A is not in the repo, so the match with the 'automated processing workflow' cannot be verified from the repo.
